payout_quote: Individuals who complete parts one and two will be compensated with a $20 Amazon gift certificate. Individuals who also complete part three will be compensated with an additional $20 Amazon gift certificate, plus an image of their brain.
steps: Open the CU Boulder Today article (2026-09-16) and find 'Study on your favorite music' (Brain Music Lab, IRB #25-0777)

Confirm eligibility: 18-25, native English speaker, little-to-no musical training, right-handed, MRI-eligible, normal hearing/vision, no music-processing disorders, no recent psychiatric diagnoses/meds
Complete the eligibility form linked in the article
Part 1: online survey (30 min); Part 2: in-person visit to the Brain Music Lab (90 min)
Part 3: practice MRI session (30 min), online survey (30 min), and MRI scan (90 min) at CINC
Receive $20 Amazon gift certificate for parts 1-2, plus another $20 for part 3 (and a brain image)
catches: Pay is in Amazon gift certificates ($20 + $20), not cash — and only for the parts you complete
You may not qualify for all activities even if enrolled (notably the MRI in part 3)
Narrow eligibility: 18-25, right-handed, little-to-no musical training, MRI-able
biggest_catch: $40 total in Amazon gift certificates (not cash) across ~4.5 hours, and enrolling doesn't guarantee you qualify for the MRI part.
eligibility: 18-25, native English speaker, little-to-no musical training, right-handed, able to undergo MRI, normal/corrected hearing and vision, no music-processing disorders, no recent psychiatric diagnoses or medications (6 months).
timing: ~4.5 hours total over several weeks (30-min survey + 90-min lab visit + 30-min practice MRI + 30-min survey + 90-min MRI scan); payment timing not stated.
